title: SOCATA TB 20 Trinidad — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the SOCATA TB 20 Trinidad with Lycoming IO-540 fuel-injected engine, constant-speed propeller, and retractable tricycle gear. The TB 20 features car-style doors with a single lever for entry, side-stick-style yoke, and a fuel selector with LEFT/RIGHT/OFF positions. Some variants use a single-lever power control that couples the propeller and throttle; verify control configuration in the specific aircraft POH before flight. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, and performance data must come from the aircraft POH. Not a substitute for qualified instruction or a type-specific checkout.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, or other numerical limitations — all must come from the specific aircraft POH.
Equipment variations exist across this model/variant. Verify items against the specific aircraft before use.
